claim_text: The knife-like object he saw is still in Berlin and is used in rituals to bring forth the Antichrist spirit, and the new leader over Iran is saying he is the one prophetically sworn in by the Quran to bring forth the Mahdi.
quote: he is the one that is prophetically sworn in by the Quran
falsify_match: The Iranian leader publicly claiming a role in bringing the Mahdi.
falsify_miss: He does not. He offers this as news that came out after his word, which is the priority question.

claim_text: An old man underground says it is time, and they devise a plan to distract the eagle so they can give a fatal blow to Israel, believing it will bring major war and the Mahdi, talking to a scientist about a megaton like Hiroshima.
quote: a plan of how to distract the eagle so they could try
falsify_match: A nuclear or major attack on Israel timed to draw America away.
falsify_miss: None. Hiroshima scale is the benchmark he chose, which would be unmistakable.

claim_text: The scientist says it has not been tested but they believe they have one working bomb, meant for a special black rocket as long as a bus, beside which are barrels of biological weapons he says came from Saddam and were the weapons of mass destruction never found.
quote: we believe we have one working bomb
falsify_match: A completed untested Iranian device found, with Iraqi-origin agents alongside.
falsify_miss: None found. Inspections have never placed Iraqi stocks in Iran, which is the part that would have to be shown.

claim_text: Cuba will be liberated within a twenty four hour period, though not necessarily the next twenty four hours, with everybody celebrating and the noose around their neck broken, followed by Holy Ghost revival and a piercing of the demonic veil over the island.
quote: it will happen in in a 24-hour period
falsify_match: A change of Cuban government completed inside a day.
falsify_miss: A slow transition, or none. He explicitly removes the near-term deadline, leaving the duration but not the date.

claim_text: Traitors and Republicans he calls rhinos should be voted out and replaced, and the Lord is pricking the hearts of pastors and others in positions who would run for office and win by his hand.
quote: would run for office and win in by the hand of the Lord
falsify_match: A visible wave of clergy candidates winning seats.
falsify_miss: None. Nobody is named, so any one such win could be claimed.

claim_text: A heavy-set Hawaiian man very respected among Hawaiian people is being brought forward to have great influence on the islands, with the emphasis on culture, over a darkness of old witchcraft covering Hawaii.
quote: he is very respected with the Hawaiian people
falsify_match: A figure of that description rising to prominence in Hawaii.
falsify_miss: None. He says he knows nothing of Hawaiian culture, and no name is given.

claim_text: Occultic darkness over Hawaii that is old and attached to something, revival coming as these things happen, and major volcanoes erupting in Hawaii, with one or two people raised up in Ireland, a dead man rising and blind eyes opening.
quote: I saw major volcanoes erupting in Hawaii
falsify_match: Major eruptions in Hawaii beyond the ordinary.
falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. Kilauea has erupted repeatedly through this period, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: The whole earth's atmosphere with loud sonic booms and fearful sights that shake the nations, some crashing down into the water, some racing across Europe, the Vatican, Russia and the Middle East, in an active pattern.
quote: FEARFUL SIGHTS YOU will see. And it will shake the nations
falsify_match: A run of damaging airbursts across those regions.
falsify_miss: None. Small fireballs are recorded daily, so only damage or a visible pattern would count.

claim_text: The war in Iran finishes quickly with nobody losing their life and only the evildoers eliminated, and a major revival breaks out among the Iranian people in the window given.
quote: that he finishes the war in Iran, that it's quickly
falsify_match: A quick end to the fighting followed by open church growth in Iran.
falsify_miss: A long war, or no revival. Nobody losing their life is the part that fails first in any real campaign.

claim_text: The blood of the Iranian martyrs is avenged and a great revival and harvest comes on behalf of the Iranian people, with Nigeria and the persecuted across the Middle East named, and the greatest harvest of souls yet to come.
quote: there'll be a great revival in behalf of the Iranian people
falsify_match: Documented mass conversions in Iran and Nigeria.
falsify_miss: None. Iranian house church growth has been reported for two decades, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: Every underground terrorist organisation is exposed before they can act, with the agencies knowing where they hide, and no rock, cave, valley or mountain to hide under, across Europe and America.
quote: there's no rock they can hide under
falsify_match: Disclosed disruptions of cells before they act.
falsify_miss: An attack succeeds. The prayer framing means either outcome can be used.

claim_text: MS-13 and the sex trafficking in California are brought to justice, and the California governor will be retired and find another job, as will Nancy Pelosi, with righteous judges, governors and members of Congress raised up.
quote: Gavin Newsom will find a new job
falsify_match: The governor leaves office and does not advance.
falsify_miss: He completes his term and runs nationally. His term ends in January 2027 either way, which weakens the claim.

claim_text: Righteous people are raised into office in America and Australia, Taiwan is preserved and will not be invaded by China with a hedge around it and around South Korea and Japan, and the people of Cuba are liberated.
quote: That Taiwan will not be invaded by China
falsify_match: Taiwan is not invaded.
falsify_miss: China invades. This is the third time in three weeks he prays against the outcome he says he was shown.

claim_text: Liberation, prosperity and blessing called over Cuba, with good days coming for the body of Christ as the dividing walls of racial tension come down and restitution comes.
quote: the dividing walls of racial tension are coming down
falsify_match: Visible reconciliation across racial lines in American churches.
falsify_miss: None. Congregations remain among the most segregated institutions in the country.

claim_text: He says he does not like touching much of what was shown the previous night because it was really dark, concerning the occult and Cuba.
quote: I don't like touching a lot of that because it was really dark
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement about what he will not repeat.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: He describes very demonic material concerning the leader of Cuba and what he was trying to do to the president through witchcraft, shown so that the body of Christ would stand in the gap and pray for him.
quote: what he was trying to do towards our president um through witchcraft
falsify_match: Nothing observable beyond the president's own state.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. This is the earliest telling in the record so far.

claim_text: The Lord used the word coward for people in political positions who will not stand for what is right and are squandering a window given to buy America more time and a better foundation before the storm, leaving only a little time and it is on a wire.
quote: They're squandering a window that I have given them
falsify_match: Nothing directly. The window is not dated and nobody is named.
falsify_miss: Nothing directly. It supplies the reason in advance for any word that does not land.

claim_text: The Lord holds the body of Christ accountable for praying for the president under demonic pressure from the deep state, and says he will expose great darkness and corruption in California that will make Minnesota look like a cakewalk.
quote: great corruption in California that will make Minnesota look like a cakewalk
falsify_match: Californian fraud findings exceeding the Minnesota cases.
falsify_miss: They do not exceed them. California is far larger, so a bigger absolute number is close to inevitable.

claim_text: The Lord said to pray for the young man who wears hoodies, whose name he did not know and is given as Nick Shirley, who is exposing darkness, and to pray protection around his life because he will shed light on things they do not want lit.
quote: Pray for this young man that has the hoodies on all the time
falsify_match: An attempt on that investigator.
falsify_miss: None. This names the man the later hoodie warning leaves unnamed, so they are the same person.

claim_text: Los Angeles and the areas under the governor are worse than Minnesota, with more darkness than can be comprehended, and great darkness also in New York and Philadelphia, with the investigator only barely scratching the surface.
quote: Great darkness is in New York
falsify_match: Corruption findings in those three cities exceeding Minnesota.
falsify_miss: None. Darkness is undefined, so any scandal in any of them would be claimed.

claim_text: Great revival comes in celebrity homes with Bible studies where the glory shows up, and the glory of the Lord shines throughout the Hollywood Hills and Beverly Hills, because the Lord is going to shake California.
quote: I saw the glory of God shine throughout the Hollywood Hills
falsify_match: A visible wave of conversions among named entertainment figures.
falsify_miss: None. Celebrity home Bible studies have been reported in Los Angeles for years, which is the weaker version already true.

claim_text: Fake daycares all over California taking millions of dollars with no children in them, as with the Somali fraud in Minnesota.
quote: There's fake daycares all in California, too
falsify_match: Childcare subsidy fraud cases brought in California.
falsify_miss: None brought. He is repeating what his son told him from the investigator's videos.

claim_text: While praying for a major shaking of Cuba the walls began to shake in the middle of the prayer.
quote: the walls begin to shake
falsify_match: The timing checks against the seismic record.
falsify_miss: It does not. Treating a coincident event as confirmation is the pattern worth recording.

claim_text: A 5.5 earthquake struck at 11:28 in the exact spot where he had seen the man trying to escape the island, twenty two miles off Cuba in the water.
quote: They had a 5.5 earthquake in the exact spot I saw
falsify_match: A quake of that size at that place and time.
falsify_miss: The record shows otherwise. He gives it as 5.5 here and 5.8 the next night, so his own figure moves.

claim_text: The man sits at a resort in a white linen shirt and trousers and black sandals in a lawn chair eating grapes and fruit brought to him, and as he leaves Cuba appears with a new marine park with roller coasters and holiday resorts.
quote: He had white linen pants on. He had sandals, black sandals
falsify_match: The Cuban leader leaving the island for a resort abroad.
falsify_miss: He stays. The white linen and sandals are the identifying details.

claim_text: A new marine park called something like Southern Caribbean with killer whales as in San Antonio and Orlando, blue roller coasters and amusement rides, beachfront hotels and new construction, with Ford in big letters selling trucks, cars and SUVs.
quote: I saw Ford in big letters on signs
falsify_match: American theme park and car companies operating in Cuba.
falsify_miss: They do not. Both would require the embargo to be lifted, which makes this unusually checkable.

claim_text: The auto industry comes to Cuba with Ford Rangers, and the body of Christ rises up there in metal buildings like an old grocery store or hardware warehouse.
quote: Trying to bring the auto industry to Cuba
falsify_match: New large congregations in industrial buildings across Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Cuban house churches already meet in whatever buildings they can get.

claim_text: Megachurches with major congregations raised up all through Cuba, people celebrating with flags twirling and weeping because they are no longer bound by a dictator.
quote: being raised up like mega churches all throughout Cuba
falsify_match: Congregations of megachurch scale in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Cuban congregations are legally capped in practice, which is what would have to change first.

claim_text: Things change quickly with financial blessing, and cigar factories all over Cuba shipping in boatloads to America, Europe, Africa and China because production goes to a much higher level.
quote: I saw cigar factories on all over the place
falsify_match: Cuban cigars shipping legally into the American market at volume.
falsify_miss: They do not. American import of Cuban cigars has been barred since 1962, which is the concrete part of this.

claim_text: Arrows come out of the Cuban factories to Canada and other places like the travel map in an Indiana Jones film, and cigars become big business and global trade.
quote: it become a big business cigars
falsify_match: A large expansion of Cuban cigar exports.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not know whether Europe and Africa already buy them, which they do.

claim_text: After images of cremation and gold coins he saw Taiwan and was told to pray for it, seeing a plan from China to take it in the middle of the night just as America did in Venezuela.
quote: just like what we did to Venezuela in the middle of the night
falsify_match: A rapid overnight Chinese operation against Taiwan.
falsify_miss: None. The Venezuela comparison is the new element and ties the two together.

claim_text: The Chinese leader is devising the plan right now and it will be just like Venezuela, with Australia and other nations only fussy about it rather than resisting, South Korea most upset and then Japan.
quote: they're devising a plan ping right now to take Taiwan
falsify_match: An invasion met with protests rather than intervention.
falsify_miss: None, or an American intervention. The muted allied response is the checkable part.

claim_text: China took Taiwan effortlessly in the vision though he prays it will not happen, and he prays against attacks on Hawaii because he keeps seeing Honolulu hit so that American military cannot go over from there to help.
quote: I kept seeing Honolulu being hit before
falsify_match: A strike on Hawaii preceding a move on Taiwan.
falsify_miss: None. Pearl Harbor is the obvious precedent the image draws on.

claim_text: A new chapter and a new era comes out of the darkness for the Cuban people, and the same for Venezuela and in the days ahead Mexico and Colombia, and he says they could see it tomorrow, Sunday or Monday.
quote: We could see this tomorrow. We could see this Sunday, Monday
falsify_match: A change of Cuban government in the following days.
falsify_miss: Nothing in those days. He names specific days here, which is rare and scoreable.

claim_text: It could be a year from now but he does not believe it will be, because the Lord warned countless times it would happen in darkness, that they will shut down the grid in Cuba and America will use cyber warfare to turn off their lights.
quote: America will use cyber warfare against Cuba and turn off their lights
falsify_match: American cyber action confirmed against the Cuban grid.
falsify_miss: The outages stay attributed to fuel and plant failure. He allows a year here, which widens the window he elsewhere gives as days.

claim_text: The Lord said a window rather than a door, so this conflict will be short-lived, and in it the president will say drill baby drill, open closed pipelines and strategic reserves to restore the petrodollar, and America becomes the oil capital of the world.
quote: The Lord didn't say a door. He said a window
falsify_match: A short conflict followed by a large expansion of American production.
falsify_miss: A long conflict, or flat production. America was already the largest oil producer when this was said.

claim_text: He points to the California governor objecting to a pipeline being reopened, which he had condemned in 2015 over a leak, as the president opening pipelines just as the Lord said.
quote: President Trump's going to open up pipelines
falsify_match: The earlier recordings name pipeline reopenings before the order.
falsify_miss: They do not, or drill baby drill was already stated policy, which it was from January 2025.

claim_text: Drill baby drill will be seen in Gaza and all kinds of places, with Israel and America as buddies over oil and gas, and possibly another oil boom in Oklahoma as in 1980s Tulsa.
quote: I believe you're going to see it in the Gaza
falsify_match: Oil or gas development off Gaza with American and Israeli partners.
falsify_miss: None. The Gaza Marine gas field has been known since 2000 and undeveloped since.

claim_text: He plays a news clip reporting that the Energy Secretary ordered the reopening of an offshore oil operation and pipeline off Santa Barbara which had ruptured in 2015 spilling nearly three thousand barrels.
quote: Its pipeline ruptured and spilled nearly 3,000 barrels
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim, though he offers it as the news catching up to the word.

claim_text: He says it is just like the Lord said and that he is told what is coming in the news before it happens, and notes people accuse him of working for Mossad.
quote: He tells us what's coming in the news before it happens
falsify_match: The earlier recordings contain the pipeline claim before the order.
falsify_miss: They do not. This is the strongest fulfilment framing he uses, and it is checkable against this corpus.

claim_text: He says he told people about the baptism of the Holy Ghost, that they need not walk in poverty, that giving is returned and that they could be healed, and that this matters more than anything he says is coming.
quote: I told them they didn't have to walk in poverty
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement of his own priorities.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Giving the population as five point six million he calls them all saved, noting more people live in Cuba than in Ireland, and asks that all five point six million from Ireland have a major revival.
quote: all 5.6 million people from Ireland will have a major revival
falsify_match: A national religious revival in Ireland.
falsify_miss: None. He confuses the Cuban and Irish figures on air while giving them.

claim_text: Some say seven million, and the Lord is calling in these small forgotten places, calling Ireland saved and on fire for Jesus and calling revival over Cuba.
quote: Ireland will be on fire for Jesus in Jesus' name
falsify_match: Measurable growth in Irish religious observance.
falsify_miss: None. Irish observance has fallen steadily for thirty years, which is the base rate this would reverse.

claim_text: Souls called in throughout Taiwan and revival called on Hawaii, on Maui, on Honolulu and over all the islands.
quote: Revival's coming on Hawaii. Revival's coming on Hawaii
falsify_match: A visible religious revival in Hawaii.
falsify_miss: None. Hawaii has among the lowest church attendance in the country, which is the base rate.

claim_text: Cultic darkness over Hawaii that looks tribal like totem poles or weird Native American things, which the Lord says is generational, a way of thinking and a stronghold, and he is bringing clarity.
quote: This is generational on Hawaii. It's a way of thinking
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. He says himself he did not know whether they practised anything of the kind.
